title: Motorcycle Maintenance
shortDescription: Learn a clear pre-ride check and the basics of routine motorcycle care.
description: Build a practical routine for checking tires, lights, chain condition, fluids and visible wear. The lessons focus on preventive care and safe inspection rather than complex repairs that require a trained mechanic.
objectives: Check tires, lights and visible controls
Understand basic chain care and warning signs

modules.title: Safe inspection habits
modules.summary: Set up the motorcycle safely before checking it.

lessons.title: Prepare a safe work area
lessons.description: Park securely, let hot components cool and gather basic tools before an inspection.

lessons.title: A simple pre-ride routine
lessons.description: Use a consistent walk-around to check the motorcycle before each ride.

modules.title: Tires, lights and controls
modules.summary: Inspect common wear points and recognize problems early.

lessons.title: Tire condition and pressure
lessons.description: Look for damage and tread wear and understand why the correct pressure matters.

lessons.title: Lights, brakes and visible controls
lessons.description: Check that lights work and inspect visible controls without attempting advanced repairs.

modules.title: Routine care and records
modules.summary: Learn basic chain and fluid checks and when to visit a mechanic.

lessons.title: Chain condition and care
lessons.description: Recognize a dry or poorly adjusted chain and learn when maintenance should be handled by a mechanic.

lessons.title: Keep a maintenance record
lessons.description: Track inspection dates, service reminders and symptoms to share with a mechanic.
